name: S2_Gate_Tracker
ac_note: reinforced timber, 3/4 cover for those behind
notes: West Gate structural HP tracker. Ogre strikes for 3d6+4 per round automatically. Click macro each round the ogre lives. HP 60→40 holding, 40→20 buckling, 20→0 breach imminent, 0 = ogre enters.
gm_notes: Gate HP 60. Ogre rams every round he is alive (free action — this is his sole purpose). Arrow slits give defenders AC 15 cover vs ranged attacks from outside. Ballista from equipment cache can fire out through slits. If party kills ogre: gate attack stops. If gate reaches 0: ogre and 1d4 spearmen pour through next round.
